_comment: 15 hand-vetted must-not-merge pairs of BASE articles (EVALS §3, M2_trap and
M2_near). Each pair names two genuinely different stories.
band=near: the two articles quote the same press-release paragraph verbatim,
so their resemblance is authored into J in [0.40, 0.60) - close enough to the
tau = 0.60 threshold that the trap gate binds instead of testing pairs that
are trivially dissimilar. Exactly 5 of the 15 are near.
band=far: different events involving the same company in the same week - the
class that an over-eager clusterer merges.

pairs.why: two takes on the same transit vote, sharing the authority's statement
two takes on the same deposit-rate move, sharing the bank's statement
two takes on the same endowment result, sharing the endowment office statement
two takes on the same port recovery, sharing the port authority statement
two takes on the same furnace restart, sharing the steelmaker's statement
Apple earnings results vs the preview written a week earlier
two different Tesla stories in the same week: a recall and charging access
two different Amazon stories: fulfillment sites and a Prime price rise
a Meta fine vs a sector piece on privacy tools
the Visa settlement vs a regulator's separate fee proposal
